repos.summary_zh: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的开源命令行视频音频下载工具，支持数千个网站。它提供丰富的格式选择、元数据修改、字幕下载及强大的后处理能力，是跨平台媒体抓取与自动归档的终极利器。
repos.summary_en: yt-dlp is a highly feature-rich command-line audio and video downloader supporting thousands of global websites. It offers powerful format selection, extensive post-processing options like metadata modification and subtitle downloading, and robust cross-platform capabilities, making it the ultimate tool for automated media retrieval and archiving.

repos.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.
repos.summary_zh: ShareX是一款免费开源的屏幕截图与文件共享工具。它集屏幕捕获、视频录制、图像标注及OCR文字提取于一体，支持自定义工作流与自动化上传，提供轻量、无广告的一站式生产力解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ShareX is a free, open-source, lightweight screen capture, screen recording, and file sharing productivity tool for Windows. It integrates image editing, OCR text extraction, and automated upload workflows into a single ad-free application. Designed for power users, developers, and creators, it offers extensive hotkey support and custom destinations for seamless workflow automation.

repos.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署
repos.summary_zh: IPTV-API是一款功能全面的IPTV直播源自动化采集与管理工具，支持多源聚合、智能校验测速及自定义频道，输出M3U、TXT及API，支持CLI、GUI和Docker多端部署。
repos.summary_en: IPTV-API is a comprehensive automated tool for IPTV live stream collection, validation, and speed testing. It aggregates sources, filters high-quality channels, and outputs customized playlists in M3U, TXT, or API formats. With support for IPv4/IPv6, Docker, CLI, and GUI, it provides a robust solution for seamless live TV playback.

repos.description: 🚀 抖音、TikTok 数据采集与无水印视频下载 API，自托管，支持 MCP 调用与 Docker 一键部署。| Self-hosted TikTok & Douyin scraper and no-watermark video downloader — async REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console for posts, profiles, comments and playlists. Self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archive, one docker compose up.
repos.summary_zh: 自托管的抖音与TikTok数据采集及无水印下载API，支持Docker一键部署、REST API与MCP。集成自愈身份池与PostgreSQL存档，提供CLI和Web控制台，适用于高效抓取与内容归档。
repos.summary_en: This self-hosted, open-source solution provides a powerful API for scraping Douyin and TikTok, delivering clean, watermark-free video and image downloads directly from platform sources. Easily deployable via Docker Compose, it features an async REST API, MCP integration, CLI, and an intuitive web console. Leveraging a self-healing identity pool and robust PostgreSQL archiving, it supports comprehensive data extraction for posts, profiles, comments, and search queries, ideal for developers seeking reliable, large-scale social media data collection and automated workflow integration.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader是抖音/TikTok下载与数据采集工具，支持高清视频、图集、直播流下载，具备批量采集、多账号管理、数据持久化及Web UI交互。基于Python开发，支持Docker部署，提供代理、多线程、断点续传等功能，适用于内容存档与数据分析。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a TikTok/Douyin downloading and data collection tool, supporting HD videos, image albums, and live stream capture. It features batch collection, multi-account management, data persistence, and Web UI interaction. Built with Python and Docker, it offers proxy support, multi-threading, and resumable downloads for content archiving and data analysis.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费无广告的追剧资源指南，通过人工精选和每日自动化检测确保资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等多类资源，社区共同维护，适合追剧爱好者快速获取可靠资源。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free guide for drama chasing resources, featuring manually curated selections and daily automated availability checks. It aggregates online videos, apps, cloud storage searches, magnets, subtitles, TVBox configs, IPTV sources, and more, community-maintained for reliable resource discovery.

repos.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。
repos.summary_zh: qist/tvbox仓库提供多种TVBox配置文件，如OK影视、猫影视等多源配置，适用于电视盒子应用实现直播与点播观看。技术亮点包括JSON配置管理、JavaScript脚本集成及代理优化，支持跨平台使用。核心价值在于简化影视源配置，提升个性化观看体验，但需注意免责声明，仅限学习研究用途。
repos.summary_en: The qist/tvbox repository offers various TVBox configuration files, including multi-source options for OK影视 and Cat影视, suitable for TV box apps to stream live and on-demand content. Key technical features encompass JSON configuration management, JavaScript script integration, and proxy optimization for cross-platform use. The core value lies in simplifying video source configuration to enhance personalized viewing, while users must adhere to the disclaimer for legal and educational purposes only.

repos.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.
repos.summary_zh: FileCentipede是一款跨平台多协议下载管理器，支持HTTP、FTP、SSH、BT及WebDAV，并集成浏览器插件，可智能提取网页音视频，实现一站式高效上传、下载与文件管理。
repos.summary_en: FileCentipede is a powerful, cross-platform, multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, SSH, WebDAV, and BitTorrent. With browser integration, it intelligently extracts online audio and video, providing a one-stop solution for high-speed uploads, downloads, and comprehensive file management.

repos.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.
repos.summary_zh: MediaGo是一款跨平台视频下载工具，内置流量嗅探技术，可自动识别并抓取m3u8/HLS流，支持Bilibili、YouTube等千余站点。提供桌面应用、Docker部署及浏览器扩展，集成AI助手技能，通过HTTP API实现自动化下载与格式转换，无需复杂配置，一键获取高清视频。
repos.summary_en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader with built-in sniffing to automatically detect and grab m3u8/HLS streams, supporting Bilibili, YouTube, and over a thousand sites. It offers desktop app, Docker deployment, and browser extension, with AI assistant integration and HTTP API for automated downloading and format conversion, no complex setup required.

repos.description: A cross-platform Electron Desktop App to stream and download any Movie, TV Series or Anime in the World. Zero Ads and Tracking
repos.summary_zh: Streambert是跨平台无广告影视播放下载工具，基于Electron技术，支持电影、动漫与电视剧的高清流媒体播放、多线程高速下载、字幕管理及个性化库追踪，打造安全极速的私人影音体验。
repos.summary_en: Streambert is a powerful, cross-platform desktop application built with Electron, designed to provide a completely ad-free and tracker-free media experience. It allows users to seamlessly stream and download movies, TV series, and anime in high definition, leveraging fast, multithreaded downloading technology. Featuring intuitive subtitle download tools, a highly customizable interface, and a comprehensive personal library for tracking watched content, it also offers daily trending discovery. Streambert ensures a fast, private, and highly customizable offline entertainment solution for every global media lover.

repos.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘
repos.summary_zh: biliup 是一款自动化直播录制与投稿工具，支持B站、抖音、Twitch、YouTube等19个平台，具备边录边传、实时预览、弹幕抓取、多机录制及AI自动切片等特性，可实现24小时无人值守运行，适用于个人主播与内容搬运。
repos.summary_en: biliup is an automated live stream recording and submission tool supporting 19 platforms including Bilibili, Douyin, Twitch, and YouTube. It features zero-disk-buffer upload, real-time preview, danmaku capture, multi-camera recording, and AI-powered highlight clipping, enabling 24/7 unattended operation for streamers and content curators.

repos.summary_zh: 跨平台视频去重工具，精准识别分辨率、水印、裁剪等变换后的相似视频。集成本地AI大模型与音频指纹技术，提供多端界面，适用于本地和NAS媒体库的高效去重与片段检测。
repos.summary_en: A powerful cross-platform tool to find duplicate videos and images, even with different resolutions, watermarks, or heavy edits. It integrates local AI vision models and audio fingerprinting, offering GUI, CLI, and Web interfaces for efficient media library deduplication and partial clip detection.

repos.description: MoonTVPlus 是基于 MoonTV v100 二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器。它在原版基础上新增了外部播放器支持、视频超分、弹幕系统、评论抓取等实用功能，提供更强大的观影体验。
repos.summary_zh: MoonTVPlus是基于MoonTV的增强版影视聚合播放器，无缝集成外部播放器、WebGPU视频超分、弹幕系统及AI智能问片，支持PWA与多端同步，为用户打造极致的私人定制观影体验。
repos.summary_en: MoonTVPlus is an enhanced video aggregation player featuring external player support, WebGPU super-resolution, danmaku, and AI search, delivering a seamless cross-platform viewing experience.

repos.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库
repos.summary_zh: 基于Tauri的跨平台B站视频下载工具，集成高清视频、CC字幕、弹幕转ASS及自动化NFO刮削。支持广告智能跳过与章节标记，一键将B站视频高效整理并导入Emby等主流媒体库，实现个性化媒体管理。
repos.summary_en: Cross-platform Bilibili video downloader featuring a modern GUI, high-quality downloads, and comprehensive media management. It supports CC subtitles, danmaku-to-ASS conversion, automated NFO scraping, and smart ad-marking. Easily download videos, courses, and bangumi, organizing them seamlessly into Emby and Jellyfin media libraries.

repos.summary_zh: 个人私有视频站，支持多网盘接入与低带宽302播放。集成短视频沉浸模式、自定义爬虫、Telegram机器人及一次性分享，助力个人轻松构建高效、私密的专属多媒体播放与管理平台。
repos.summary_en: This is a powerful personal private video website featuring multi-cloud drive integration and low-bandwidth 302 redirect playback. It integrates a TikTok-style short video swipe mode, custom spider scripts, Telegram bot connectivity, and one-time share links, helping individuals easily build a highly efficient and private media library.

repos.summary_zh: 本工具基于.NET Core与Vue构建，专为抖音用户提供视频同步解决方案。支持收藏夹、喜欢视频及指定博主作品的一键同步，内置刮削功能，可直接接入Emby或Jellyfin媒体库，实现便捷的个人视频管理与播放。
repos.summary_en: Built with .NET Core and Vue, this tool offers a comprehensive video synchronization solution for Douyin users. It enables one-click syncing of favorites, liked videos, and designated creators' works across multiple accounts, featuring built-in metadata scraping for seamless Emby or Jellyfin integration. With Docker deployment and QR code login support, it facilitates personal video library management and playback, making it an ideal choice for media enthusiasts.

repos.summary_zh: CTV项目是一个创新的AI驱动视频处理工具，核心价值在于通过智能算法自动化视频编辑与内容生成流程。应用场景广泛，包括社交媒体视频制作、在线教育内容开发及广告创意实现，显著提升视频生产效率与创意表达。技术亮点包括集成先进的深度学习模型进行视频分析、智能剪辑与个性化推荐，支持跨平台操作，确保高效稳定的处理能力。
repos.summary_en: CTV is an innovative AI-powered video processing tool designed to automate video editing and content generation workflows. It serves content creators, media companies, and educators by streamlining video production for social media, online education, and advertising. Key technical highlights include the integration of advanced deep learning models for video analysis, intelligent editing, and personalized recommendations, offering cross-platform compatibility and high efficiency.

repos.description: 用一根 USB 数据线把安卓手机/平板变成 Windows 的第二块显示器——是真扩展桌面而不是投屏镜像。端到端延迟实测 5–11 ms，支持触摸反控，拔线即摘屏。全部源代码由 AI 编写。
repos.summary_zh: DroidExtend 是一款通过 USB 数据线将安卓手机/平板转化为 Windows 真扩展显示器的工具，支持窗口拖拽与触摸反控，端到端延迟仅 5–11ms。它基于 adb 隧道传输、NVENC 硬件编码与虚拟显示驱动，无需 Wi-Fi，即插即用，为多屏办公提供低延迟、高可靠的显示扩展方案。
repos.summary_en: DroidExtend is a tool that converts an Android phone or tablet into a genuine secondary display for Windows over a USB cable, not a screen mirror. It supports dragging windows to the phone and touch back control, achieving end-to-end latency as low as 5–11 ms. By using adb reverse tunneling, NVENC hardware encoding, and a virtual display driver, it requires no Wi-Fi or third-party apps, providing a low-latency, reliable extended desktop experience for multi-monitor productivity.
